_doc: Shading lane round 2 world-rim policy (rim.py inner_rim, selected by $ROSACE_RIM_STYLE; the lane's stills set it). The rim sits on the first pixel inside the silhouette line, never the line; only where that pixel is in a shadow tone of its material (the side the key light leaves dark); tinted by the material; runs of run_min..run_max px with a 1 px break; at most max_share of the silhouette ring (PX-P19 <= 3%). Level 'full' (the effect light) keeps the DESIGN s9 cyan outline rim. full_as_world: the lane's stills bake no effect layer, so the 'full' attack frames (N1, Q) take this world rim as well; the cyan outline returns with the effect light (runtime rim LUT, DESIGN s9).
